title: [Core] Lesson Calendar display range - Default partner keeps 06:00-23:00 in Daily view
description: AC 01 - Regression - Partners without a custom display-hour setting keep the existing 06:00-23:00 Daily view.
preconditions:
- Login as HQ/CM staff with access to a non-Nichibei partner/location.
- Partner has no custom Lesson Calendar display range setting.
- Lessons exist on the same date at 05:30-06:00, 06:00-06:30, 23:00-23:30, and 23:30-23:59 in partner timezone.
steps_actions:
1. Open SF Lesson Calendar Daily view for the target location/date.
2. Inspect visible hour labels.
3. Search the calendar surface for the 05:30 lesson.
4. Inspect the 06:00 and 23:00 sections.
steps_result:
1. Calendar loads successfully.
2. The first visible hour is 06:00 and the last visible hour is 23:00.
3. The 05:30 lesson is not displayed and no error is shown.
4. The 06:00 lesson appears in 06:00; the 23:00 and 23:30 lessons appear in the 23:00 section.
steps_data:
1. partner = default/no custom config
2. expected range = 06:00-23:00 inclusive
3. start = 05:30
4. start = 06:00, 23:00, 23:30
suite: Configurable Display Hour Range on Lesson Calendar (LT-111003)

4. start = 05:59
